When 65g of zinc reacts with 32g of sulfur, 97g of zinc sulfide is produced.
When 65g of zinc reacts with 40g of sulfur, the mass of zinc sulfide produced is still 97g.
Which statement explains this observation?
A
Some of the zinc sulfide evaporates.
B
The reaction rate is slow.
C
The reaction stops before it is complete.
D
Zinc is the limiting reactant.

options.label: A
options.text: Some of the zinc sulfide evaporates.

options.label: C
options.text: The reaction stops before it is complete.
